headline.title: Ireland’s public sector walks out for 24 hours
headline.quip: The strike lasted 24 hours. The pay deal behind it had been stalled considerably longer.
headline.summary: Hundreds of thousands of Irish public-sector workers walked out for 24 hours over a stalled pay deal, the first such strike since 2009. Most schools, colleges and universities closed, and thousands of medical appointments were cancelled.
